clips.title: The story
paras: Alba Fairmoon sends Alliance help to Westfall's Longshore to gather murloc gills. She fears the crop blight may reach the Great Sea, and the gills could reveal whether the coastal waters are tainted.

Westfall is already near ruin, with crops failing, farmers displaced, and bandits roaming the roads. Alba Fairmoon fears the blight may be draining from inland fields into the Great Sea. If the coast is tainted, the fish that feed Westfall's poor and grace Stormwind City's tables could vanish. That loss could tip an already strained kingdom into outright famine.

Murlocs are stubborn and violent, but their amphibious bodies make them natural signs of water quality. Their breathing constantly filters seawater, leaving their gills exceptionally receptive to poisons, blight, and unnatural pollutants. Alba Fairmoon hopes to gauge the contamination by studying fresh gills from the murlocs prowling the Longshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.

Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see... These gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.
